senses.sense_definition: Used to suggest a possible alternative or solution if no better option is available.

examples.text: If you miss the bus, you can <w>always</w> walk home.

target_lang_translations.fr: Si tu rates le bus, tu peux <w>toujours</w> rentrer à pied.
